# port_virtual_mcp_tool (Resource)

Manages a virtual MCP tool under the `_virtual_mcp_tool` system blueprint.

Virtual tools customize a single underlying Port or MCP connector tool with a fixed name, description, and argument rules. Attach them to a [`port_virtual_mcp_server`](virtual_mcp_server.md) through the server's `virtual_mcp_tools` relation.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "port_virtual_mcp_tool" "list_skills" {
  identifier  = "skills_distribution_list_skills"
  title       = "list_skills"
  name        = "list_skills"
  tool        = "list_entities"
  description = "Lists skills visible to the connected user."
  expose_arguments = "listed"
  arguments = jsonencode({
    blueprintIdentifier = { value = "skill" }
    include             = { value = ["$identifier", "$title", "description"] }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The tool name exposed to MCP clients (up to 48 characters)
- `title` (String) The display title of the virtual tool
- `tool` (String) The underlying Port or MCP connector tool name (for example `list_entities` or `github_list_commits`)

### Optional

- `arguments` (String) Per-argument rules for the underlying tool, as a JSON object keyed by dotted argument paths
- `description` (String) The description shown to agents when the tool is listed
- `expose_arguments` (String) Whether agents see all underlying tool arguments (`all`) or only arguments listed in `arguments` (`listed`)
- `icon` (String) The icon of the virtual tool
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the virtual tool entity
- `teams` (Set of String) The teams the virtual tool belongs to

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation date of the virtual tool
- `created_by` (String) The creator of the virtual tool
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update date of the virtual tool
- `updated_by` (String) The last updater of the virtual tool
